title: Read-only Business Central shell action inventory smoke test
goal: Open Business Central read-only, confirm the expected sandbox and company URL context, and inventory harmless visible shell/page actions without clicking them.
safetyGates: Abort if URL does not contain MCP_1_20260210.
Abort if company URL parameter is not RM-DEMO.
Inventory visible actions only; do not click them.
Abort if a dialog with OK, Yes, Ja, Post, Preview, Delete, New or Edit appears.
Do not open a new BC page unless a later run-plan explicitly permits it.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central opens with existing storageState.
Instance MCP_1_20260210 is confirmed from URL.
Company RM-DEMO is confirmed from URL parameter.
Visible safe shell/page actions are listed without clicking.
Risky actions are either absent from the inventory or recorded as forbidden-not-clicked.
Result JSON contains no-write, no-post, no-preview, no-draft, no-setup-change, no-company-switch and no-action-click flags.
nextSafeAction: Create and run a read-only Playwright smoke that inventories visible shell/page actions without clicking them, after agent:run-plan and agent:subagent-plan pass.
